format.restarts: Goal kicks, corner kicks and throw-ins are used; no offside.
format.playing_time_policy: Equal playing time for every player
format.uneven_numbers_policy: Share players with the opposing team when numbers are very uneven; 6v6 is the minimum
format.not_used: No penalty kicks in regular play
format.goalkeeper_handling: Standard goalkeeper handling within the penalty area; opponents back off five steps once the goalkeeper has the ball in hand.
format.heading_policy: Deliberate heading is not allowed. Change possession at the point of the header.

sources.note: Fictional placeholder — not a real league. Used only to exercise SmallSide's league-profile modularity.
